svg.aria-label: Profile banner for Ho Dinh Tin, also known as Tyrise, a developer and songwriter based in Saigon, Vietnam. Terminal style layout with an ASCII portrait on the left and a SYSTEM.INFO panel on the right listing location, languages C, C++, Java, JavaScript and Python, web skills HTML5, CSS3, React and Node.js, and contact links for Facebook, Instagram, SoundCloud, email and Beacons.
svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
